_doc: Declared multi-trial reports: ONE article reporting SEVERAL registered trials (and possibly a combined analysis). Read by harness/multi_trial_report.py: the article is linked to EVERY registration it reports; each trial's population is a witness span in held bytes and its relevance to a review is derived from that span against the review's own population rules; a combined analysis is recorded and NEVER imported. Declared by the evidence lane (Claude Opus 5.5), 2026-09-27, from the dapagliflozin HFmrEF/HFpEF review. EMPERIAL (empagliflozin HFpEF review) added 2026-09-27: registry_results.per_outcome states what a held, examined registry result says for a named outcome; exploratory_harms are shown, never pooled.

reports.citation: McMurray JJV et al. Circulation 2024 (DETERMINE Randomized Clinical Trials), DOI 10.1161/circulationaha.123.065061

witness.span: 504 patients with HF with preserved ejection fraction (DETERMINE-Preserved)

findings.serious_adverse_events: 26/252 vs 19/249 (up to 30 days after last dose, no later than day 119)
findings.heart_failure_serious_events: Cardiac failure 2/252 vs 4/249; cardiac failure acute 1/252 vs 2/249; cardiac failure congestive 2/252 vs 0/249
findings.primary_composite_cv_death_or_worsening_: not an outcome measure of this 16-week trial

registry_results.note: Preserved-only, primary registry results. Examined, not admitted: admitting any of these changes a served number and needs Mahmood's signature.

Composite cardiovascular death or worsen.basis: a 16-week trial whose posted outcome measures do not include cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure

witness.span: 313 patients with HF with reduced ejection fraction (DETERMINE-Reduced)
In an exploratory post hoc analysis of both trials combined (DETERMINE-Pooled)

reports.full_text_state: NOT_HELD: not in PMC; the repository copy (pure.eur.nl, other-oa) answers 403 to the PDF; no open supplement. The Preserved-specific event and safety data were examined in the trial's own posted registry results instead.
